$comment: Copy to .eagerworks/pr-review.json in the target repo and trim to what you need — every field is optional. This example blends a Rails and a Node extraFocus entry; keep only what applies to your repo.

extraFocus: Rails: every query scoped to an Organization filters through current_user.organization, not just organization_id from params
Node: every Prisma query on a tenant-scoped model includes orgId from the session, never only from the request body
